name: Azusa 108 Jimusho
source:
Main character Azusa is a female private detective. While on a major case of finding the missing relative she also takes a request to investigate consecutive rape cases that occurred at her girls' school dorm.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主人公梓是一名私家侦探。在调查亲属失踪这一重大案件的同时，她还接到另一项委托：调查自己就读的女子学校宿舍里接连发生的强奸案。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
